**Windsurf Paros** is the ultimate Cycladic adventure for thrill-seekers and water lovers. Known for its reliable winds and scenic beaches, Paros is home to some of Greece’s most famous windsurfing destinations. Combine that with a relaxing stay at **Antiparos Rooms** and convenient **car rental from AGGELOS Rentals**, and you’ve got the perfect holiday.

* * *

### **Top Places to Windsurf in Paros**

#### **Golden Beach – Windsurfing for All Levels**

Golden Beach (Chrissi Akti) is one of the best places to **windsurf in Paros**. It offers moderate winds and shallow waters, ideal for beginners and intermediates. The beach is long and sandy, with plenty of space for practicing.

#### **New Golden Beach – Action and Events**

Just north, **New Golden Beach (Tserdakia)** caters to advanced surfers too. With a natural reef and side-shore wind conditions, it’s a prime spot for experienced windsurfers. It’s also the site of the **Paros Windsurf Center**, offering rentals, windsurf lessons, and even **wingfoil** equipment.

> ![Windsurf Paros at Golden Beach in summer.](/media/2025/07/Windsurf-in-paros.jpg.webp)

* * *

### **Windsurfing Services and Gear Rental**

Both beaches are well-equipped with **windsurfing schools**, rental shops, and facilities. From sails and boards to private lessons, you’ll find everything you need to enjoy your **windsurf Paros** experience.

* * *

### **Explore Paros and Antiparos with AGGELOS Rentals**

To make the most of your trip, rent a car in Paros or Antiparos from **[AGGELOS Rentals](https://antiparosrentacar.com/)**. Their fleet includes compact cars, SUVs, and automatic vehicles, perfect for island exploration.

With your **Paros rent a car**, you can easily reach windsurfing beaches, mountain villages, and ferry ports. If you’re staying on Antiparos, they also offer **Antiparos rent a car** services with pickup at the port or your hotel.

* * *

### **Where to Stay: Antiparos Rooms with Sea View**

After an active day of **windsurfing in Paros**, head to peaceful Antiparos for rest. At **[Antiparos Rooms](https://antiparosrooms.com/)**, you’ll enjoy stunning sea views, elegant Cycladic design, and total relaxation.

> ![](/media/2025/07/IMG_9796-scaled.jpg.webp)

Antiparos is just a short ferry ride from Paros (Pounta – Antiparos route), making it easy to split your time between windsurfing action and island serenity.

* * *

## **Plan Your Windsurf Paros Escape**

Whether you’re riding waves at Golden Beach or exploring the island with a **[Paros rent a car](http://antiparosrentacar.com/)**, your Cycladic adventure awaits. Stay nearby at **Antiparos Rooms**, and let the Aegean wind guide your journey.
